brief: A self-hosted, Netflix-style home for your anime: your MyAnimeList and AniList lists, streams, predictions, and watching together with friends. Playful and a little cheeky, clearly its own thing, not a Netflix look-alike.
criteria: Success: unmistakably not Netflix, says screen + anime at a glance, recognisable at 16 px in a browser tab, works in one colour.

concepts.name: Catchlight
concepts.idea: A screen that looks back at you with an anime eye's catchlights.
rationale: Screen and anime in one shape: no letters, no film strips, no ribbon N
Catchlight Rose (#E11D5C) on ink: its own colour, not Netflix red
A small-size cut with bigger catchlights keeps it readable at 16 px

recommendation: Catchlight in Catchlight Rose: the symbol alone for icons, the horizontal lockup in the app's top bar.
next_steps: Use in the web app and desktop app
Animate the catchlights (a blink) for the splash screen
